card.name: Physical in physical-chemical stability statements
card.fires_on: The word "physically" or "physical" (also the start of "Physically") in admixture text, right before "stable" or "compatible". It appears next to "chemically" in dilution and storage statements.

modes.label: Physically and chemically stable
modes.description: "Physically" paired with "chemically" ahead of the word stable, describing diluted solutions held for a set time.
modes.example: Although Ondansetron Injection is chemically and<< physically>> stable when diluted as recommended, sterile precautions
